audit.why: 50.9% over 387 Emerald+ games and difficulty 6/10 match a lane that genuinely trades hands: Sion owns Level 1 and Level 6, Heimerdinger owns 4-5 and the first-item siege window.

audit.whatIsWrong: Five of seven chart rows contradicted their own why-text and the packet chart. whys[0] says he charges a full Q knockup before your turret exists (Sion) but the chart said Heimerdinger; whys[2] ends 'it stays even' (Skill) but said Sion; whys[3] says 'you zone him off CS and own the wave' (Heimerdinger) but said Sion; whys[4] calls his ult 'the textbook way to delete you' (Sion) but said Heimerdinger; whys[5] has you out-zoning him (Heimerdinger) but said Sion; whys[6] calls it 'a positioning coin-flip' (Skill) but said Sion.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Sion / Skill / Skill / Heimerdinger / Sion / Heimerdinger / Skill, proposed as matched full+content pairs.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer's interaction lines were template filler: dosFull[0].d gave no cooldown, dontsFull[1].d ('Fight into his W shield') carried boilerplate about burning your own cooldown, and phases[4].why never named Unstoppable Onslaught or its timer.
audit.corrected: Decimating Smash knocks up and stuns only when fully charged, on 10/9/8/7/6s. Soul Furnace shields and reactivates after 3 seconds for magic damage, so poke and step out of the 500 range instead of standing in it. Unstoppable Onslaught is 140/100/60s and covers 7500 units, steering only slightly.

audit.why: report[8] already lists early anti-heal, which is the right answer to Glory in Death's attack healing and to Soul Furnace's max-health growth.

edits.before: Upgraded E or W deletes his all-in — choose per fight. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Sion's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Unstoppable Onslaught is 140/100/60s and flies past your nest onto an immobile yordle — stay near turrets and sidestep the line.

edits.before: Charged = knockup. Dodge it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Fully charged Q knocks up and stuns on a 6-10s timer. Dodge the windup.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Soul Furnace re-fires after 3s for magic damage — poke, then back off.

notes: Deliberately did NOT claim your CH-3X stun interrupts Unstoppable Onslaught. The kit file carries no channel flag on Sion's R and Riot's text does not say the charge is interruptible, so per the no-speculation rule the advice was written as 'sidestep the line' instead. Worth a verified pass later — if hard CC does stop the charge, that is the single best line in this matchup and belongs in phases[4].why. Packet defect 'never names any of Sion's abilities' is now partly closed in the full layer (Decimating Smash, Soul Furnace, Unstoppable Onslaught); Roar of the Slayer's armour shred is still unnamed and matters for his E poke.
